heading: Reports
lead: A State or local law enforcement agency or organization that receives a grant under this subchapter shall submit to the Attorney General an annual report that includes—

tree.text: the number of staff employed to administer programs;
the number of individuals who participated in programs; and
an evaluation of the effectiveness of grant programs.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 3796jj–6 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

ancestors.heading: SUPPORT FOR LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS AND FAMILIES
